sources.note: Reviews standard Cloudboom Strike — same midsole as LS
keyFindings: Supercritical Helion HF hyper foam delivers 'the softest foam from On so far' with strong propulsive forefoot feel; 'makes a given pace feel significantly easier'
Platform runs slightly narrow; heel movement on camber roads; better for midfoot strikers than rearfoot strikers
Responsive bounce with strong propulsive forefoot engagement; functions best at 5K–10K paces
Minimal visible wear after 25 miles; durability expected average for a racing shoe
Best for competitive runners targeting 5K–half marathon who tolerate a snug, narrow fit

sources.note: Reviews standard Cloudboom Strike — same midsole as LS
keyFindings: Bouncy, light ride with exceptional energy return from Helion HF foam; 'serious bounce' engages best at tempo and race paces
Narrow midfoot platform (65mm) creates 'slight instability' and midfoot wobble especially at slower paces; not debilitating but noticeable
Drop-in midsole design places 22mm forefoot / 14mm heel cushion above carbon plate; overall 9.7/10 responsiveness rating
Racing and marathon conditions only — not suited for easy-paced training; squeaking reported indoors
Best for racing and tempo runs; neutral runners only; not suitable for overpronators
